release.description: Search and organize Box content, summarize and compare documents, extract metadata with Box AI, and collaborate through comments and shared links.

interface.short_description: Search and work with Box files
interface.long_description: Connect your Box account to find, understand, and act on your content without leaving the conversation. Search across files and folders, ask questions about documents, summarize and compare them, and extract key information. Keep content organized by creating folders, copying and moving files, and adding metadata, and work with others through comments and shared links. Requires a connected Box account and respects your existing access permissions.
interface.default_prompt: Find the latest vendor agreement in my Box files.
default_prompts: Find the latest vendor agreement in my Box files.
Compare the contracts in my Box folder and summarize their differences.
Find all files in Box related to the project kickoff and copy them into a new folder called Project Kickoff.
